purpose: design the visible interface so people can recognize, read and operate it correctly, consistently across the product
entry_criteria: A design system or style foundation exists or is planned
procedure: Use the design system components and tokens first, and add new ones only when no existing one fits.
Set layout, spacing and hierarchy so the main action on each screen is clear.
Design every state: empty, loading, error, success and disabled, not only the filled state.
Check text size, contrast and touch target size against the accessibility requirements.
Check the designs at the supported screen sizes and with long and translated text.
Hand over specifications and assets with named components, so engineers do not redraw them.
acceptance_criteria: Components come from the design system or are specified
Designs hold at supported sizes and long text
validation_method: Design lead review and accessibility check.

validation.check: check each screen has empty, loading, error and success states
measure text contrast of the main text and controls against the required ratio

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A settings screen uses the standard form components, adds an inline error state and a disabled save button, and the grey helper text is darkened to meet the contrast ratio.
